contacts.institution_name: 21 Nap - Fiatalok a Tudatosabb Életért Egyesület

country.evidence_quote: "Erasmus+ DIY" was an Erasmus+ Training Course designed to empower aspiring youth workers to bring their own Youth Exchange ideas to life. The main activity took place between 1-9 March 2025 in Gyula, Hungary. 25 young youth workers from Lithuania, Greece, Italy, Romania, Poland, Portugal, Spain, and Hungary joined together for this transformative learning experience.
